dimensions.assessment: Affects the Department of State's Bureau of Overseas Building Operations and specified congressional committees.
dimensions.evidence: Bureau of Overseas Building Operations of the Department of State... appropriate congressional committees

dimensions.assessment: Imposes planning, comparison, and reporting obligations on the Department of State prior to executing nonstandard embassy and consulate construction projects.
dimensions.evidence: submits to the appropriate congressional committees a notification of such project, including... lifecycle cost... completion date... security

dimensions.assessment: Involves comparative lifecycle cost estimations for construction projects, but does not state new federal appropriations.
dimensions.evidence: comparison of the estimated full lifecycle cost of the project

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a new statutory congressional notification requirement for all new U.S. embassy and consulate compound construction projects utilizing nonstandard designs.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of State may only carry out a covered project that uses a nonstandard design if... the Secretary submits... a notification

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent notification requirement for current and future embassy and consulate compound construction projects.
dimensions.evidence: includes such projects that are in the design or pre-design phase on the date of the enactment of this Act

missing_information: The number of future construction projects that will use nonstandard designs is not specified.
importance_detail.rationale: H.R. 7054 requires the Secretary of State to submit a detailed congressional notification containing cost, schedule, and security comparisons before obligating funds for embassy or consulate construction projects using nonstandard designs.
